title: Concrete Pump for Secondary Structure Columns and Beams
seoTitle: Concrete Pump for Secondary Structure Columns and Beams | Pinjin
description: Match secondary-structure column and beam pours to Xingtai catalogue compact pumps. Electric 15 lists secondary structure at 15 kW, 8–10 m³/h and 1–3 cm stone. Electric 10 Series and Electric 20 are compared only on published rows.

answerBlock.what: Secondary-structure columns and beams are short, repeated pours. Pinjin’s Electric 15 catalogue line names small building sites and secondary structure: 15 kW, 8–10 m³/h, 15–20 m vertical, 60–80 m horizontal, 1–3 cm stone, 450 kg. Electric 10 Series and Electric 20 are neighbours, not nicknames for the same machine.
answerBlock.who: Builders and labour teams pouring secondary beams, ring beams, small columns and floor elements on grid-powered sites whose stone and pipe stay inside a compact-pump table.
factors: Whether the mix stone stays inside 1–3 cm (Electric 15) or 1–2 cm (Electric 20) or 2 cm and below (Electric 10 Series)
Output: 8–10 m³/h versus Electric 10 Series theoretical 21 m³/h with only 25 m horizontal
Vertical / horizontal metres against the printed row
Footprint: 450 kg / 900 mm wide versus 400 kg / 800 mm versus 900 kg Electric 20

faqs.question: Does Pinjin publish a pour volume per column or beam?
faqs.answer: No. Catalogue output is theoretical m³/h, not a site guarantee and not a column-volume table. Send typical member size, stone and pipe length with the inquiry.

faqs.question: Is Electric 15 the only secondary-structure pump?
faqs.answer: It is the model whose application list names secondary structure. Electric 10 Series lists the same application family with 25 m horizontal. Electric 20 is a 22 kW / 900 kg trailer with 1–2 cm stone. Match the row; do not treat them as one machine.
